description: This file declares template functions for generating command-line flags and handling configuration data in the 'cuttlefish' project. It includes utility functions for formatting flags, processing collections, and merging JSON objects, as well as a function for processing environment specifications with callbacks.

methods.name: std::string GenerateFlag(const std::string & name,const T & value)
methods.description: Generates a command-line flag string for a given name and value, using the fmt formatting library.

methods.name: std::string GenerateVecFlag(const std::string & name,const T & collection)
methods.description: Generates a command-line flag string for a collection of values, joined by commas.

methods.name: std::string GenerateInstanceFlag(const std::string & name,const cvd::config::EnvironmentSpecification & config,T callback)
methods.description: Creates a flag string based on environment instances and a callback function applied to each instance.

methods.name: Result<std::string> ResultInstanceFlag(const std::string & name,const cvd::config::EnvironmentSpecification & config,T callback)
methods.description: Similar to GenerateInstanceFlag, but wraps the values in a Result type with error handling.

methods.name: MergeResults
methods.description: Merges two lists of strings into one. (Implementation likely concatenates lists)

methods.name: MergeTwoJsonObjs
methods.description: Merges the source JSON object into the destination JSON object.
